title: sufr create no longer has --allow-ambiguity
body:
`sufr create --allow-ambiguity` (`-a`) turned off the `--dna` filter in the suffix gathering of `SuffixArrayBuilder`, so `--dna --allow-ambiguity` built the same suffix array as no flags, and `-a` alone did nothing. Before 9433918 it also enabled the N-run shortcut in `find_lcp`; the LCP cache replaced that.

## Proposal

Remove the flag, the `allow_ambiguity` parameter of `SuffixArrayBuilder::with_dna_options`, and the `allow_ambiguity` fields of `SufrFile` and `SufrMetadata`. Keep header byte 2 at format version 6: write `1 - is_dna`, which is 1 when every suffix is indexed, and ignore it on read.

## Cost

Breaking for library callers of `with_dna_options` and readers of the removed fields. The four fixtures built with `-a` (`1n`, `2n`, `2ns`, `long_dna_sequence_allow_ambiguity`) keep their names and headers; the CLI tests compare only suffix arrays, and those match builds without `--dna`.
